subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM reply threading be controlled by a new `dmThreadMode` account option, or should it be expressed through the existing `replyToMode` threading contract?
rationale: The implementation is small, but adding a second threading knob is a product/API choice and the previous merged fix made DM thread suppression intentional after delivery failures.

options.title: Unify the threading API
options.body: Prefer extending or clarifying the existing Google Chat threading contract so users do not get two overlapping reply/thread controls.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as separate
options.body: Allow the new DM-only knob, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs/help, and real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the prior DM thread-suppression behavior until a maintainer sponsors a broader Google Chat threading design.

recommendation.title: Unify the threading API
recommendation.body: Prefer extending or clarifying the existing Google Chat threading contract so users do not get two overlapping reply/thread controls.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the prior DM suppression fix, maintainer verification, and earlier Google Chat thread support history.
